Subject: Annual commitment — invoicing options and VAT info

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Procurement asked me to confirm the invoicing approach for our €120,000 committed spend for 2026. Specifically:

- We'd like Redwood to issue invoices we can map to our ledger and PO.
- Can you confirm whether you can split the annual amount into multiple prepay invoices (we'd prefer 50/25/25) or if Redwood requires a single prepay?
- VAT: NordicSoft is EU-registered (NO VAT: NL123456789). Do you need an EU VAT form for reverse charge, or will Redwood invoice VAT-exempt?
- Could you also provide a drawdown tracking template so our finance team can reconcile consumption vs committed spend monthly?

Attached is our signed PO (we will send the official PO to procurement@ as well).

Attachments: [Signed_PO_NordicSoft_20251124.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Marta
Head of Finance — NordicSoft

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — invoicing options and VAT info

Hi Marta — great to hear and thanks for sharing the PO. Looping in Lauren (AM) and Ben (Billing) so we can finalize ops.

High level options from our side:
1) Single prepay invoice for the full committed amount (we typically do this for prepay contracts). Redwood will issue an invoice for the gross amount; if you provide your VAT registration and reverse-charge is applicable, we mark it accordingly (no VAT charged).
2) Staged prepay (we can do 50/25/25 as requested). Each tranche is a prepay invoice with its own invoice number and due date; drawdown statements are issued monthly.

Proposal (recommended for your ledger): we will issue three prepay invoices as 50% / 25% / 25% with the following provisional schedule:
- Invoice 0001 (50%) issued upon PO acceptance — due Net 30
- Invoice 0002 (25%) issued 90 days after Invoice 0001 — due Net 30
- Invoice 0003 (25%) issued 180 days after Invoice 0001 — due Net 30

VAT handling: provide your VAT reg number (you included NL123456789 — thanks). Ben will confirm the exact VAT text we place on the invoice (reverse charge, Article 44/196 wording for intra-EC supplies). If we need any additional documentation (W-8/B2B attestation) we'll flag it.

I attached a drawdown tracker template and will ask Ben to confirm invoice numbers and exact wording. Please confirm that the 50/25/25 schedule works and that invoices should be payable to Redwood Inference Ltd (EUR IBAN will be on the invoice).

Best,
Grace
VP, Customer Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: [RWI_Drawdown_Tracker_NordicSoft.xlsx (xlsx)]
